name: bkesari-mobile
description: Android and iOS apps for LadWani, Education and TaskList: each project's own site (and its own sign-in) in a Capacitor shell. See README.md.

scripts.add:android: for a in ladwani education tasklist; do (cd apps/$a && npx cap add android); done
scripts.add:ios: for a in ladwani education tasklist; do (cd apps/$a && npx cap add ios); done
scripts.sync: for a in ladwani education tasklist; do (cd apps/$a && npx cap sync); done
